Added: Config import now handles every server in a pasted config, not just the first — one mcp-connection block per HTTP-transport entry. Also recognizes VS Code's {"servers": {...}} shape alongside the existing {"mcpServers": {...}} one, and unwraps an mcp-remote bridge entry (npx -y mcp-remote <url> [--header ...]) into the real remote URL and headers directly, no local process involved

MCP responses now render through the shared CodeEditor component instead of a plain <pre> — same JSON syntax highlighting, search, and selection every other response view has. Text content is sniffed for JSON and pretty-printed automatically, since plenty of MCP servers hand back JSON-encoded strings as untyped "text" content
Fixed: The very first Cmd+A inside an mcp-connection block selected the whole document instead of scoping to the block, which made Cmd+A, Cmd+A, Cmd+X duplicate content instead of cutting just the block — block types are now registered with the paste/selection subsystem, matching every other plugin's blocks

An mcpurl block could pick up an auto-link mark on paste/import, causing a click meant to place the cursor to instead open the URL in the external browser — marks are now disabled on this block, matching voiden-rest-api's own URL node

"Could not discover capabilities" now reads as a warning, not an error, and explains that the server may just be starting up or briefly unreachable — discovery failing doesn't mean the block is broken; a tool/resource/prompt name can still be typed manually

title: Initial Release
description: MCP client plugin for Voiden — connect to an external MCP server over HTTP and run an operation against it.

Added: MCP Connection block (/mcp) with a Server URL child and an Operation child
Support for list_tools, call_tool, list_resources, read_resource, list_prompts, get_prompt
Reuses the existing Auth block and assertions-table with no extra configuration
Connect to any Streamable-HTTP MCP server, including one running on localhost
Paste a Claude Desktop / Cursor / VS Code style mcpServers JSON config to fill in the block's URL and headers automatically
Query Params and Path Params block support — resolved onto the server URL, same as REST requests
Request building now goes through the same shared header/auth/cookie utilities voiden-rest-api uses, including inherited auth from .voiden-inherited.void ancestors
